question: Choose the correctly spelt word:
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Effervescence .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The question asks for the correctly spelt word among the given options.
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **"Effervescence"**, which means the property of forming bubbles or being lively and enthusiastic.
 
• Option 1, **Effervescence**, is correct, whereas the other options are incorrect due to incorrect spelling:
 
 
• **Option 2:** Effervescense - Incorrect due to incorrect ending "sence" instead of "scence".
 
• **Option 3:** Efferescence - Incorrect due to missing "v" after "Effer".
 
• **Option 4:** Effervesance - Incorrect due to incorrect ending "sance" instead of "scence".
 

Correct answer: **Effervescence**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Learning spellings can be simplified by breaking words into syllables. For example, "Ef-fer-ves-cence".
 
• Familiarity with commonly used words and their correct spellings can improve both vocabulary and accuracy in spelling.
